'''Ajalo Nills''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]], who worked as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Nills was a member of a mercenary group that was led by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Dantin Vellos]]. When the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], the mercenary group was hired to travel there and kill [[Osten Dal'Nay]], the leader of the [[Cularin Militia]]. Nills accompanied the group and they ambushed Dal'Nay on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He fled into the Cularin jungle and the mercenaries pursued. They eventually surrounded him next to a stream and attacked him with melee weapons. However, the [[heroes of Cularin]] then arrived and they attacked and defeated Nills and the other mercenaries.
